scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm following up on my housing loan application. Can you tell me the status of my application? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. You were approved for a Conventional:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. What is my interest rate and the total costs of this loan? Also, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 7.025%. The record does not include total loan costs. There are no high-cost or negative amortization flags on your loan.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? Additionally, what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to an affiliate institution. Your debt-to-income ratio is between 30% and 36%, which is the ratio of your monthly debt payments to your monthly income.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the information. I think I have all the details I need.

<Neutral>
The agent provided clear and accurate information about my loan status, interest rate, and other details. However, I was hoping to get more information about the total loan costs, but it seems that information is not available in the record. Overall, the interaction was satisfactory, but I would have appreciated more detailed cost information.
